name: Igorrr
description: '''Gautier Serre''' (born 5 June 1984), better known by his stage name '''Igorrr''', is a French musician, composer and producer. Under the Igorrr alias, he combines a variety of disparate genres, including [[black metal]], [[baroque music]], [[breakcore]], and [[trip hop]], into a singular sound. Serre is also part of the now disbanded side-projects Whourkr and Corpo-Mente. The Igorrr project has evolved into a full-fledged group with vocalists Laure Le Prunenec and Laurent Lunoir, drummer Sylvain Bouvier, guitarist Martyn Clément and bassist Erlend Caspersen. In 2021, both vocalists left the band and were replaced by JB Le Bail and Aphrodite Patoulidou; the latter was later replaced by Marthe Alexandre. In 2024, Rémi Serafino became drummer. Gerda Iguchi succeeded Alexandre as vocalist in 2026.
